title: Design System: Goli Pavan Sai Krishna

display.purpose: Hero name only; soft amber glow at rest; animates wdth/wght in the cool entrance. 15.4vw below 768px.

headline.purpose: Section titles, with neon glow and a drawn gradient bar; contact title runs larger; menu links reuse the voice.

title.purpose: Project names; glow on card hover.

lead.purpose: Hero tagline and About bio; light serif at 350.

caption.purpose: Italic serif for captions, notes, categories.

label.purpose: Buttons, tags, nav links, hero project names, footer.

shadows.name: frame-rest
shadows.purpose: Screenshot frame, over a blurred amber pool.

shadows.name: glass-edge
shadows.purpose: Warm 1px rim and top highlight on screenshots; no inner wash.

shadows.name: field-lip
shadows.purpose: Colour field rising over the previous section.

shadows.name: title-neon
shadows.purpose: Section title glow (blue 0.45em in cobalt, white-hot 0.5em in amber).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for nearly all transitions and reveals.

motion.name: card-spin
motion.value: rotate 360deg, 8s linear infinite; runs only while in view; hidden <768px and reduced motion
motion.purpose: Travelling border light on glow cards.

motion.name: frame-rim
motion.purpose: Conic rim light on hovered screenshot frames.

motion.name: orb-drift
motion.value: drift 18–32s ease-in-out alternate; paused out of view

motion.name: hero-cool
motion.value: 1.9s ease-out, 48ms per letter + 0.25s; white-hot wdth75/wght200 → glass wdth100/wght700

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 0.9s, transform 1.1s from translateY(30px) blur(8px); stagger 80ms capped 480ms

motion.name: title-rise
motion.value: 1.25s ease-out, 90ms per word, from translateY(112%) rotate(4deg) in amber-hot
motion.purpose: Section title words; bar draws 1.3s after 0.45s.

motion.name: bead
motion.value: 0.9s ease-out, 38ms per tag, from translateY(14px) scale(0.9) blur(4px)

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: html.motion absent: no entrance, drift, rotation, tilt, parallax, cursor, count-up; reveals are 0.5s opacity only; network draws one static frame

components.css: .ds-btn{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.65rem;min-height:3.25rem;padding:0 1.5rem;border-radius:999px;font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque','Avenir Next',sans-serif;font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1;text-decoration:none;overflow:clip;isolation:isolate;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color .35s}.ds-btn::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:-1;border-radius:inherit;transform:translateY(102%);transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn svg{width:1.1rem;height:1.1rem;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-btn-molten{background:#FF9A3C;color:#140D0A;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,246,225,.55),0 14px 30px -14px rgba(255,120,40,.6)}.ds-btn-molten::before{background:#FFF3D6}.ds-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-btn:hover::before{transform:none}.ds-btn:hover svg{transform:translateY(3px)}.ds-btn-molten:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7),0 22px 40px -16px rgba(255,130,50,.75)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #FFC877;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Glow Card
components.description: Signature container: gradient border, rotating conic light, cursor spotlight, title glow on hover.
components.html:
Databases

Cut p99 latency 62%, from 479 to 183 ms.
components.css: @keyframes ds-spin{to{rotate:360deg}}.ds-glow-card{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:clip;max-width:26rem;padding:2rem;border-radius:1.6rem;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,170,90,.5),rgba(255,154,60,.1) 35%,rgba(255,154,60,.1) 65%,rgba(224,80,31,.45));box-shadow:0 26px 56px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.8),0 0 46px -22px rgba(255,120,40,.3);transition:box-shadow .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-glow-card::before{content:'';position:absolute;z-index:-2;left:50%;top:50%;width:160%;aspect-ratio:1;translate:-50% -50%;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,transparent 0deg 235deg,rgba(255,154,60,.85) 290deg,#FFF3D6 318deg,rgba(224,80,31,.8) 340deg,transparent 360deg);animation:ds-spin 8s linear infinite}.ds-glow-card::after{content:'';position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:1.5px;border-radius:calc(1.6rem - 1.5px);background:linear-gradient(165deg,#2A1B13,#1C130E 60%,#1A110D)}.ds-glow-card:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 34px 70px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.85),0 0 70px -18px rgba(255,130,45,.5),0 0 0 1px rgba(255,190,120,.18)}.ds-glow-title{margin:0 0 1rem;font-family:'Bricolage Grotesque','Avenir Next',sans-serif;font-size:2rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.025em;line-height:1.05;color:#F7EBDD;transition:text-shadow .5s}.ds-glow-card:hover .ds-glow-title{text-shadow:0 0 .5em rgba(255,150,60,.55)}.ds-glow-body{margin:0;font-family:'Source Serif 4',Georgia,serif;font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.6;color:#D6C3B2}.ds-num{color:#FFC877;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:lining-nums tabular-nums;text-shadow:0 0 .6em rgba(255,150,60,.75),0 0 .18em rgba(255,196,120,.6)}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-glow-card::before{display:none}.ds-glow-card:hover{transform:none}}

components.css: @property --ds-a{syntax:'<angle>';inherits:false;initial-value:0deg}@keyframes ds-rim{to{--ds-a:360deg}}.ds-frame{position:relative;max-width:28rem;border-radius:1.25rem;box-shadow:0 34px 64px -34px rgba(0,0,0,.85),0 14px 26px -14px rgba(0,0,0,.6);transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),box-shadow .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-frame::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:20% -4% -16% -4%;z-index:-1;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,140,50,.4),rgba(224,80,31,.14) 60%,transparent);filter:blur(26px);opacity:.85;pointer-events:none}.ds-frame-btn{position:relative;display:block;width:100%;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:inherit;background:#251812;overflow:clip;cursor:pointer}.ds-frame-btn::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,190,120,.3),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,238,215,.4)}.ds-frame-shot{display:block;aspect-ratio:16/10;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F4F1EC 0 14%,#FFFFFF 14%)}.ds-frame-rim{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;padding:1.5px;background:conic-gradient(from var(--ds-a),transparent 0deg 230deg,rgba(255,154,60,.95) 300deg,#FFF3D6 330deg,transparent 360deg);-webkit-mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);-webkit-mask-composite:xor;mask:linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box exclude,linear-gradient(#000 0 0);opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s;pointer-events:none}.ds-frame:hover{transform:translateY(-10px);box-shadow:0 60px 90px -44px rgba(0,0,0,.95),0 26px 60px -30px rgba(255,120,40,.38)}.ds-frame:hover .ds-frame-rim{opacity:1;animation:ds-rim 2.6s linear infinite}.ds-frame-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #FFC877;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview:
This is a warm AI lab at night: a soot-and-umber room with drifting amber light, where a live node network thinks behind the name and every block of evidence sits in a card with a light travelling around its edge. The origin is a glassblowing hot shop (the name cools from white heat, bullet marks are drawn threads of hot glass, screenshots get an annealed glass edge). The user then redirected it toward a living network and glowing, highlighted surfaces. What ships is both worlds: glass-shop heat as the material, network and neon glow as the effects.

The density is generous. Type runs at viewport scale, sections breathe (6 to 11rem of vertical padding), and project cards give the screenshot and the claims equal weight. Light does the work that lines and boxes would do in a cooler system. Headings glow and get a drawn bar underneath, figures glow amber, and tags are glass beads that turn molten on hover. The page changes colour twice, the way glass cools. First comes a cobalt field for the stack, then an amber field for contact, and each rises over the previous section with a rounded lip.

The user has explicitly rejected: monospace as the dominant face, terminal or console framing, status-light or instrument-panel motifs, grid overlays and scanlines, anything that reads as technical documentation, a plain document-like page, and an unexplained hero object (the earlier molten-glass orb).
keyCharacteristics: Warm dark ground (soot, umber) with one hot accent family (amber, amber-hot, white-hot, ember).
Two full-bleed colour fields (cobalt, amber) that rise over the page with a rounded top lip.
An interactive 2D canvas node network across the hero, masked away from the text column.
Glow cards on every block, with a rotating conic border light, a cursor spotlight, and optional tilt.
Neon highlights: glowing section titles with a drawn gradient bar, glowing figures, bead tags, a glowing active nav link.
Choreographed motion that is gated entirely behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.

rules.name: The One Heat Rule
rules.body: Every warm light on the page is one gradient family, running from white-hot through amber to ember. A new glow uses that family. It never introduces another hue.

rules.name: The Cooling Fields Rule
rules.body: The page changes ground only twice: umber, then cobalt (stack), then amber (close). Fields rise over the previous section with a rounded top lip (`field-lip`) and a 1px white inset highlight. They are not alternating stripes.

rules.name: The Inverted Field Rule
rules.body: Inside the amber field, titles and text turn soot, the title bar runs from soot to scorch brown, and the title glow becomes white-hot. Cards stay dark islands, so their contents keep glass text and the cursor keeps its light-ground styling off them.

rules.name: The Serif Speaks, The Grotesque Names Rule
rules.body: Sentences are always Source Serif 4, and names, titles and controls are always Bricolage Grotesque. No monospace anywhere.

rules.name: The Glowing Figure Rule
rules.body: Every number inside a project claim is wrapped as a figure. It renders in amber-hot at weight 600 with lining tabular numerals and a two-layer glow (`0 0 0.6em rgba(255,150,60,0.75), 0 0 0.18em rgba(255,196,120,0.6)`), and it counts up from zero when 60% visible. Figures are the neon of the prose, so they are never bolded without the glow.

rules.name: The Hierarchy of Light Rule
rules.body: Glow strength follows importance: project cards are brightest, stack and contact cards take the default, and About cards are quietest. A new card takes the default glow unless it is primary evidence.

rules.name: The Glow Plus Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every raised surface pairs a dark drop shadow (for depth) with an amber ambient (for heat). A shadow without the warm layer reads as a foreign component.

dos: **Do** put every new content block in a glow card, and choose its glow level by The Hierarchy of Light Rule.
**Do** build every warm light from the white-hot, amber, ember family, and pair it with a dark drop shadow.
**Do** wrap every number in a claim as a glowing, counting figure.
**Do** pause any perpetual animation (card rotation, orbs, network) when its element is offscreen, and remove it under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**Do** mask decorative light (network, orbs) away from text and section edges, so type always sits in clean air.
**Do** gate cursor-driven effects (spotlight, tilt, reach, custom cursor) to `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`, and give coarse pointers a self-driven or static equivalent.
**Do** keep touch targets at 44px or more (lightbox dots 2.75rem, toggles 2.9–3rem).
donts: **Don't** use monospace as a dominant face, terminal or console framing, status lights, instrument-panel motifs, grid overlays or scanlines.
**Don't** set sentences in Bricolage Grotesque or names and titles in Source Serif 4.
**Don't** introduce a third colour field or a non-amber accent hue on the umber ground.
**Don't** place an unexplained decorative object in the hero. The network is the hero's only object.
**Don't** add an inner colour wash over screenshots; the glass edge is only the 1px warm rim and top highlight.
**Don't** run the conic card light on screens below 768px.
